credits.title: Credits and licenses
credits.intro: KineAid uses exercises from open databases. Thanks to all creators and contributors!
credits.kineaid: Own set of rehabilitation exercises, written for KineAid.
credits.fedb: Open exercise database in JSON format with photos, released into the public domain.
credits.wger: Open source fitness app and exercise database. Texts and images are under Creative Commons licenses; the author and license are shown with each exercise.
credits.custom: Exercises your physiotherapist adds remain the property of the physiotherapist.
credits.disclaimer: KineAid does not replace professional advice. Only do exercises as prescribed by your physiotherapist and stop if it hurts.
